parameters.name: tier
parameters.description: The tier of the target (0 or 1 by default 0).

parameters.name: relay
parameters.description: 1 to reach tier 2 through the resolved tier 0/1 target.

parameters.name: hardware_id
parameters.description: The hardware id the image is for.

parameters.name: version_patch
parameters.description: Patch version of the image (whole number).

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: The signature of the image, 128 hexadecimal digits.

parameters.name: downgrade_from
parameters.description: The version installed now (major.minor.patch), for a downgrade.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: The name of the board the image is for.

parameters.name: min_bootloader
parameters.description: The oldest bootloader that may take the image (major.minor.patch).
